senses.gloss:
Śiva_Dīkṣita
of 17th-18th Cent. son of Govinda Dīkṣita of the Caturdhara family, an. grandson of Nīlakaṇṭha, resident of Kūrpagrāma on the bank of Godāvarī.
-Gaṅgāṣṭaka. Stotra. Baroda II. 12189.
-Japavidhi. Ben. 144 (inc.). SB. 121 (a..).
-Dharmattattvaprakāśa. composed in 1776 C. E. See Kane, HDS. I. ii. p. 1231b. See under the text.
-Namaskāravidhi. Ben. 144.
-Vāpikūpataḍāgotsargavidhi. See under the text.
-Vijñānabhairavodyotasaṅgraha. See under the text.
-C. on Śivamahimnasstotra of Viṣṇu. See under the text.
-Ṣaṇṇavatiśrāddhanirṇaya. See under the text.

Śiva_Dīkṣita
son of Digambara Sūri.
-C. Arthaprakāśikā on Adhikaraṇamālā of Bhāratī Tīrtha. NS. Press 157.

Śiva_Dīkṣita
surnamed Kāśī Dīkṣita.
-Rudrapaddhati.
See under the text.

Śiva_Dīkṣita
-Piṣṭapaśumīmāṃsākhaṇḍana. mīm. See under the text.

Śiva_Daivajña
preceptor of Gaṇeśa Daivajña (a. of Jātakālaṅkāra, BBRAS. 362).

Śiva_Daivajña
father of Śaṅkara Daivajña (a. of Gotrapravaramañjarī-sāroddhāra, Baroda I. 7657).

Śiva_Daivajña
identity not specified.
-Akṣaracintāmaṇi or Trikālajñānākṣaracintāmaṇi. jy.
See under respective titles.
Addl. mss.:
Allahabad D. IV. 1046. 3605. BHU. 1210-11. Gottingen II. 12. 4601. Jha G. N. III. 11217. Kuru. Uni. I. 422. II. 2. Prayag II. 4846 (inc.). RORI. II. B. 8296. III. B. 8252. [Page100-a. IV. 2866. XVIII. 4205. XXV. 4461. SB. New D.. IX. 37444. 37545. ii. 101449. Shum Shere 184. VRI. III. 9764 (inc.).
-C. Vivṛti on Anantasudhārasa. SB. New D.. IX. 35523. 35527.
-Grahaprabodha. See Sen, Bibl. of Maths. p. 199. See under the text.
-Janmacintāmaṇi. See under the text.
Addl. mss.:
Allahabad D. IV. 4421. SB. New D.. IX. 37040 (inc.).
-Muhūrttacintāmaṇi. See under the text.

Śiva_Daivajña
son of Kṛṣṇa Daivajña, son of Divākāra Daivajña of Bharadvājagotra.
-Muhūrtacūḍāmaṇi. See under the text.
Addl. ms.:
Allahabad D. IV. 4335.

Śiva_Daivajña
alias ºjyotirvid, son of Nāga Daivajña, wrote a. the request of Deva Jyotirvid of Āṅkoṭagrāma.
-Muṇḍitaprahasana. See under the text.
-Saṅkrāntipaṭala. Udaipur II. 182, 13.
-Saṅkrāntiprakaraṇa. See under Saṅkrānti.

Śiva_Bhaṭṭa
father of Nāgoji Bhaṭṭa (a. of Paribhāṣenduśekhara, RORI. XVIII. 3469 (inc.).).

Śiva_Bhaṭṭa
-Bhṛgubhāskarāṣṭaka. Nagpur Uni. 1415.

Śiva_Bhaṭṭa
-Śāntiprayoga. TD. XXV. 3432 (inc.).

Śiva_Bhaṭṭa
-Śrāddhanirṇaya. See under the text.

Śiva_Varman
King, mentor of Viśveśvara Bhaṭṭa (a of Kāyasthadharmapradīpa, IO. 1653).
-Nandīśvarapaṅktividhāna. Nagaur II. 1681. [Page185-b]
-Parārdhasaṅgrahasāra or Parārdhasārasaṅgraha. jy. Bṛhatsūcī, Nepal I. p. 118. Nepal II. p.. 225-26.
-Rāgamālā. RORI. VIII. 951.

Śiva_Śarman
(identity not specified)
-Anāhateśvarastuti. Udaipur SS. I. 435.
-Āśaucadarpaṇa. SSPC. I. I. 44.
-Ubhayamukhīgodānapaddhati. Gough p. 167.
-Tulābhārapaddhati. Gough p. 167.
-Paddhaticintāmaṇi. National Libr. Nepal III. ii. p. 89.

Śiva_Śarman
alias Rāmacandra Kekkara.
-Svānubhavādarśa.
Pt.. Rāmakṛṣṇa Pt.. Works, 1923.
See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 2670.

Śiva_Siṃha
king of Mithilā, brother of Padmasiṃha, son of Devasiṃha, grandson of Bhavasiṃha. He was patron of Vidyāpati (a. of Puruṣaparīkṣā etc. L. 1922).

Śiva_Sūrī
son of Tryambaka Bhaṭṭa of Mahājana family an. father of Vāsudeva. later than 1680 C.E. [Page207-a.
-C. Vivaraṇa on Āśaucatattva of Mahādeva. Burnell 135b. Hz. II. 1506. TD. 18627-28. XXV. 288.
See Kane, HDS. I. ii. 1232a.
-Kuṇḍakaumudī or Kuṇḍamaṇḍapakaumudī. See under the text.
-C. Kuṇḍāloka on above. See under the text.
See Kane, HDS. I. ii. 1232b.

Śiva_Sūri
-Cidambareśvarapūjāvidhāna. MD. 8627.

Śiva_Svāmin
a Poet. under Avantīvarman, q. in Rājataraṅgīṇī, 5, 34; in Kavikaṇṭhābharaṇa, 4, 1. 5. 1; in Skm. v.. 1103. 1188; in Sbhv. v.. 438. 710. 810. 1416. 1051. 1140. 1756. 1826. 2062. 2098-99. 2100-01; ŚP. v.. 3396. 3511; in ZDMG. 27 (1873) 92-93.

Śiva_Svāmin
a grammarian. q. by Kṣīrasvāmin, in Kṣīrataraṅgiṇī; in Gaṇaratnamahodadhi, 2. 52; in Mādhavīyadhātuvṛtti.
See Y. Mimamsak, Saṃ. Vyā. Kā Itihās, Vol. II. p. 109.

Śiva_Svāmin
-Kāladīkṣā or Dīkṣāvidhi. tantra. IO. 8024.
(enlarged the Kalādīkṣā (Dīkṣāvidhi?) of Manodatta, see Report XXIX).

Śiva_Svāmin
ment. in Madanapārijāta; in Kālādarśa, Smṛticandrikā, Parāsara, Mādhavīya.
See Kane, HDS. I. ii. 1232b.

Śiva_Svāmin
ment. a. poet. Pāṇinian, See Y. Mimamsak, Saṃ. Vyā. Kā. Itihās, p.. 72. 498-99.

Śiva_Svāmin
disciple of Sadāhlāda.
-Ānandalaharī (a. exposition of Kākīmukhamantra). IO. 8013. [Page225-a.

Śiva_Svāmin
a. authority on dharma.
-Kṛṣṇābhyudaya. S. V. Uni. I. 413-14 (inc.).
-C. Vivṛti on Gāyatrīmantra. tantra. SB. New D.. I. iii. 52335. VI. ii. 87691.
-Śivasvāmīpurāṇa. See below.

Śiva_Svāmin
alias Śivācārya alias Śivopādhyāya.
-C. Uddyota on Vijñānabhairava. along with Kṣemarāja. See under the text.
